geographic.caption: Geographic holdout, strict_geo; 2023–2025. Original baseline probabilities; fitted candidates are calibrated. Points are recorded APs; differences subtract recorded APs on identical support. 95% paired one-degree spatial-block bootstrap intervals use 500 recorded replicates. Comparator: Persistence (chosen on val_select).

reliability.caption: Temporal test, 2023–2025. Recorded equal-frequency reliability bins; each point retains its recorded bin mass. The second panel expands the low-probability range; the dashed line is perfect reliability.

per_year.caption: Temporal-test AP by issue year. Original baselines and calibrated fitted candidates; all values are recorded, with no annual intervals.

area_budget.caption: Recorded recall at 5% and 10% of eligible cell area per issue week. Crossing cells contribute fractionally; positive contributions are pooled over weeks. Original baselines; calibrated fitted candidates.

h2.caption: H2: retrospective minus strict AP, calibrated selected candidates. The recorded 95% paired month-block interval is shown without a point: the artifact does not record the paired point estimate. The frozen H2 rule tests whether this interval contains zero; it is not an equivalence test.

map.selection_rule: Largest n_primary sum among complete 2024 target weeks with national prediction coverage; ties choose the earliest issue date.
map.caption: Issue 2024-09-02, target [2024-09-02, 2024-09-09) UTC. Derived example: largest observed detection total among complete 2024 weeks with national prediction coverage; earliest tie. Calibrated strict predictions outside held-out blocks, strict_geo predictions inside them. Right: observed primary detection count per cell (log1p color scale). ADM1 outlines are pinned boundaries. Week selection and counts are descriptive.
